_about: Press, reviews, and coverage of the Goran Ivanovic Group / Eastern Blok (2004-2012). Pull quotes only, never full text. verified=true means the page text was read on the accessed date; false means the item is known only from a search snippet or the band's own promo copy. Null dates are unknown, not forgotten. Field names follow press/SCHEMA.md (origin/better-than-tv-reviews-2026-10-04). namesDoug is true only where the page text read names him; false means not confirmed. approved stays false until Doug OKs an entry for the site.

entries.title: Goran Ivanovic Group (Balkan Song Records)
entries.author: Budd Kopman
pullQuotes: The energy that pours out of the speakers will literally bowl you over before you know what happened.
Goran Ivanovich Group is a winner from any perspective.
entries.notes: Misspells the leader's name in the last line.

entries.title: Goran Ivanovic treasures his Balkan roots
entries.author: Mike Mineo
pullQuotes: ...showing the world what an undiscovered treat Balkan music is.
entries.notes: Feature that discusses the album.

entries.title: WORLD MUSIC: Goran Ivanovic fuses Balkan folk, jazz
entries.author: Guy D'Astolfo
entries.notes: Concert preview/profile of Goran; quotes are Goran's, not the writer's, so none are kept.

entries.title: Goran Ivanovic [Group] Live at Serbian Cultural Club St. Sava, 2006-04-08
entries.author: Brian Skalinder (taper)
entries.notes: Fan-taped show at Serbian Cultural Club St. Sava, Chicago. Taper says the band stretched out more than usual. Not a review, but the only concert document found.

entries.title: EASTERN BLOK: Folk Tales
entries.author: Tim Pieri
pullQuotes: A wonderful collective of East European melody, along with Free Jazz out of Chicago.
entries.notes: Quote lightly trimmed from the original sentence.

entries.title: Eastern Blok: Folk Tales
entries.author: Kevin Fitzpatrick
pullQuotes: The band are extremely talented.
entries.notes: Lukewarm: the reviewer wanted vocals. Decide deliberately whether to display it; do not cherry-pick the rating.

entries.title: Folk Tales (Eastern Blok, self-produced)
entries.author: Budd Kopman
pullQuotes: Folk Tales is tighter and more complex than the first album, while retaining the earlier energy and abandon.
Eastern Blok is most definitely a band to catch live.
entries.notes: Read in Chrome; WebFetch gets 403 from this site. A Wayback copy exists (snapshot 2022-05-17) but WebFetch cannot reach web.archive.org.

entries.title: Eastern Blok (band-supplied biography)
pullQuotes: relentlessly innovative work (Los Angeles Times)
the ensemble playing is often breakneck and consistently challenging (Downbeat)
blazing virtuosity and sheer beauty (Acoustic Guitar)
alluring as it is complex (Minor 7th Magazine)
entries.notes: Second-hand: the band's own bio quoting four outlets. The original LA Times, Downbeat, Acoustic Guitar, and Minor 7th pieces are NOT located; do not publish these quotes on the site as verified until they are. The same bio mentions NPR, Chicago Public Radio's Chicago Undercover, the 2005 John Lennon Songwriting Competition finalist, and the film Wanted.

entries.title: Eastern Blok
entries.author: Brian Baker
pullQuotes: An exotic favorite within the Chicago music scene.
entries.notes: Event listing blurb, likely partly promo-derived. Calls Goran Serbian though other sources say Croatian-born.

entries.title: Eastern Blok bringing its distinctive sound to the Blind Pig
entries.author: Kevin Ransom
entries.notes: Preview for the Blind Pig, Ann Arbor, built on a Michael Caskey interview. Quotes are Caskey's; one says the new material is 'more thematic, and more developed', which is likely about Underwater.

entries.title: Interview: Goran Ivanovic
entries.author: David Leicht
entries.notes: Interview with Goran, mostly about the Kapsalis duo; low value.

entries.title: In the Music Spotlight: Goran Ivanovic Trio
entries.author: Jeff Elbel
entries.notes: Mentions Eastern Blok in passing as a former group (2016, Goran Ivanovic Trio piece). Text seen only as an excerpt on Goran's press page; URL is from a search result and the article was not opened.

entries.title: Eastern Blok
entries.author: Kyle Gilkeson
entries.notes: Tour announcement for a 14-date August 2010 tour featuring Matt Ulery's 'The Underwater Suite', the material that became the album. Page shows publication 2013-04-23 and update 2010-07-30; the 2010 date is used.

entries.title: Tasty Eastern Blok coffee
entries.notes: 'Tasty Eastern Blok coffee', a Matt Ulery interview preview. Seen only as a Google snippet; the real URL has an ID suffix and was not opened. Search result dated 2011-12-01.

entries.title: E-week
entries.notes: 'E-week' listing. Google snippet says the band would play 'all original compositions, mostly from Underwater'. Confirms the album existed by Dec 2011. Page not opened (connection reset).

entries.title: Jazz This Week: Frank Vignola and Vinny Raniolo, Madeleine Peyroux, Eastern Blok, Marcus Lewis, Miles Davis Jazz Festival, and More
entries.outlet: All About Jazz / St. Louis Jazz Notes
entries.author: Dean Minderman
entries.notes: Calls the show at Pop's Blue Moon (St. Louis) a celebration of the release of the new CD Underwater. Suggests the release party was May 2012, so the 2011 year may be wrong or just the first-copies date. Confirm.

entries.title: For those of us with multiple headphones, which ones are you listening with now? (forum post)
entries.outlet: Head-Fi.org forum (thread 'For those of us with multiple headphones, which ones are you listening with now?')
entries.notes: The only listener write-up of Underwater found. A forum member (name not captured) discusses the album, praising Goran's 'understated classical guitar parts' per the Google snippet. The post sits on an unidentified page of a 1,600+ page thread; the snippet's page link now points to a 2024 page. Find the exact post and author before using.

entries.title: The Reader's Guide to the World Music Festival
entries.author: Peter Margasak (signed 'PM')
pullQuotes: display an impressive mastery of the disparate genres that inform Ivanovic's tunes
a proggy fussiness
entries.notes: Short blurb in the Reader's World Music Festival guide (Chicago, Sept 14-20, 2007), on the 'brand-new Folk Tales'. Mixed: praises the players' command of the styles, but says they too often play with a 'proggy fussiness' that makes it hard to enjoy. Author initials from the page; the festival guide runs under several writers, so confirm Margasak. Both quotes are trimmed.

entries.title: The List: October 29-November 4, 2009
entries.author: Peter Margasak
entries.notes: Eastern Blok opens a show at the Old Town School of Folk Music (7 PM, $22). The entry's blurb is about the headliner, whose name was not captured. Mention only.

entries.title: Serb-o-riffic films and music
pullQuotes: locals Eastern Blok will play their fluid and vivid Balkan-inspired jazz
entries.notes: 'Serb-o-riffic films and music': Eastern Blok at Katerina's after Emir Kusturica screenings, on a Wednesday ('tonight') and Wednesday July 23. Year inferred as 2008 (July 23 was a Wednesday; page is tagged Vol. 37 No. 43). Posting date 2008-07-16 is therefore inferred. No byline shown on the page.

entries.title: TRG Music Listings (Goran Ivanovic Group dates)
entries.notes: Bare gig listings, seen only as Google snippets, for the Goran Ivanovic Group at HotHouse (2004-03-12, with Shooglenifty), Hideout/Jazz Showcase (Jazz Institute of Chicago Jazz Club Tour), Around the Coyote Fall Arts Festival, and others across 2004. Useful as a dated record of when the group formed and where it played. Individual URLs are on chicagoreader.com/news/trg-music-listings-NN; not opened.

entries.title: Goran Ivanovic Group, The Goran Ivanovic Group
entries.author: James Scott
pullQuotes: The passion and urgency at which this group plays is heard in every note.
entries.notes: Nov/Dec 2005 issue of this acoustic-guitar review site. This is the source of the Minor 7th quote ('extraordinary pan-cultural ensemble...') in the band's bio and press copy, so that one is now sourced. Read through WebFetch summary; confirm the full text and the exact wording of the bio quote against the page before reuse.

entries.title: Goran Ivanovic Group (Balkan Song), Soundcheck
entries.author: Bob Keelaghan
pullQuotes: navigates odd time signatures with speed, control, and taste
entries.notes: Short 'Soundcheck' item on Goran Ivanovic Group (Balkan Song) in the February 2006 issue, scanned on the Internet Archive. Read via a WebFetch summary of the scan's OCR text; confirm the quote against the scan. No rating.

entries.title: Eastern Blok, Folk Tales
entries.author: Patrick Ragains
pullQuotes: The band sounds spontaneous and live on this well-balanced recording.
Eastern Blok should have a bright future.
entries.notes: Sept/Oct 2007 issue; read in full in Chrome. Positive. Also quotes DownBeat second-hand: 'offers up fire rather than ice, and the guitarist's amalgamation of flamenco, Balkan, classical, blues, and jazz keeps his band pushing forward almost all of the time.' That is probably from DownBeat's 2006 review of the first album (see downbeat-goran-ivanovic-group-2006-06). Calls the leader 'Serbian transplant'.

entries.title: KlezCalendar: Goran Ivanovic Group, NYC, Mar 27
entries.author: Ari Davidow
entries.notes: Calendar entry for the show at Makor, New York, Monday 2006-03-27, 7:30 PM, $12. Repeats the Minor 7th quote and cites the Chicago Tribune calling Goran a 'lightning-fingered guitarist': a second-hand Tribune reference; the original Tribune piece is not located and could be the source of the Tribune quote noted in other press copy.

entries.title: JazzPRESS, October 2012
entries.notes: October 2012 issue (a PDF at jazzpress.pl). A Google snippet shows a passage on how Eastern Blok formed and its use of Balkan and Russian folk music, apparently in an interview with Matt Ulery. Seen only as a snippet; the PDF was not opened. Worth reading in full.

entries.title: Goran Ivanovic Group, 3 stars
entries.author: Mitch Myers
pullQuotes: saxophonist Doug Rosenberg serves well as his instrumental foil.
entries.notes: Only source is Doug's own old press page as captured by Wayback (2017). Taken from press/candidates.json (another session's index, 2026-10-05), not checked by me. The original DownBeat page or issue is not located. The first real DownBeat review of the band; the 2008 promo bio's DownBeat quote ('breakneck and consistently challenging') may come from a later review, since this quote differs. Star rating shown as 3 of 5 per that index.

entries.title: DownBeat, January 2013 (mention)
entries.notes: DownBeat January 2013 issue (a Scribd copy). Snippet reads 'In the quartet Eastern Blok with guitarist Goran Ivanovic, all of the compositions are tied to Balkan traditions.' Probably in a feature on Matt Ulery. Seen only as a Google result titled 'Downbeat-January2013' on Scribd; the link was not captured. This is the first confirmed DownBeat mention; the page and author need finding, and it is a mention, not a review.

gigLog._about: Dated shows of the Goran Ivanovic Group / Eastern Blok, taken from the titles of fan recordings in the Internet Archive Live Music Archive (taper Brian Skalinder and others), pulled 2026-10-05 via archive.org advancedsearch. Title metadata only; no audio or text copied. The search reported 75 results but only about 50 were readable and many were duplicate formats, so this list is incomplete. Archive page for any entry: https://archive.org/details/<archiveId>. Dates and venues are as the uploaders titled them and are not independently confirmed.

gaps: HotHouse (31 E. Balbo, Chicago) searched 2026-10-05: no review of a show there found. Evidence of shows: recordings of 2005-06-24 and 2006-12-15, a 2004-03-12 Reader listing (with Shooglenifty), and Goran's January 2001 solo show. The Chicago Bar Project memorial page does not mention the band.

No college newspaper article found for any campus stop (searched 2026-10-05: Daily Princetonian, Michigan Daily, Cornell Daily Sun, Fredonia Leader, The Gateway, Daily Illini). Google's index of old student papers is patchy, so this does not prove none exist. Check each paper's own archive search and Wayback.

No professional review of Underwater found after Google, Bing, and several search-tool queries (2026-10-04). Rate Your Music shows no reviews. Only previews, a release-party listing, and one forum comment exist.
Underwater release year unclear: 2011 per most listings, but a St. Louis listing calls the 2012-05-17 show a release celebration.
No post-show concert reviews found, only previews and one fan recording.

Out-of-town venue and local-paper searches run 2026-10-05 (Boston, Cleveland, Pittsburgh, Cincinnati, Cedar Rapids, Iowa City, Denver, Fort Collins, Milwaukee, Madison, St. Louis, Toledo, Binghamton, Philadelphia, NYC): no local paper review or preview found. The search tool returns few local-paper pages, so this is not proof. Not yet tried: each paper's own archive search.

Minor 7th quote in the bio is now sourced (James Scott, Nov/Dec 2005). Original LA Times and Acoustic Guitar pieces, and the DownBeat 'breakneck and consistently challenging' line, still not located; the DownBeat 'fire rather than ice' quote is only second-hand via Minor 7th.
AllMusic page for the Goran Ivanovic Group album blocked (403); unknown whether it has a review.
